info.title: Microestate API
info.description:
A comprehensive property management system API that handles landlords, tenants, properties, leases, and billing.

## Authentication
This API uses NextAuth.js for authentication with JWT tokens. Most endpoints require authentication.

## Base URL
All API endpoints are prefixed with `/microestate/api`
